main.summary: Describes a writer or source session that blocks opening a new writer transfer for the same item.

property.name: ItemID
property.summary: Transfer item identifier associated with the conflict.

property.name: TransferFamily
property.summary: Transfer family that owns the conflicting session.

property.name: Mode
property.summary: Transfer mode of the conflicting session.

property.name: Status
property.summary: Current status of the conflicting session.

property.name: Updated
property.summary: Last-updated timestamp used to rank the most relevant conflict.
